parkingAndRideshare: Parking is available at Eau Claire Plaza and the Calgary Curling Club. Rideshare drop-off and pickup is at 2nd Street SW, outside Gate 2. Expect a short walk to the festival entrance.
bagPolicy: Small bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 in are welcome. All bags are subject to search. Clear bags are recommended; outside food, glass, and professional cameras are not permitted.
reentry: Re-entry is allowed with a valid wristband and the same-day ticket. Keep your wristband intact and scan out with Guest Services before leaving.
accessibility: Accessible entry is available at Gate 2 with level pathways, viewing platforms, accessible washrooms, and a dedicated Guest Services team. Contact the team on arrival for assistance.
